scene: Pushing through the curtain, you reach an illuminated cliffside transit dock.
picture: A flat side-view of a stone transit platform on a level ground line. Far left, an open iron freight lift rests at the platform. The curly-haired boy in a denim jacket stands left. Center, a tall service elevator shaft features an open door accessed by a ladder. Far right, a wooden rowing boat floats at the dock edge.
shown: an open steel freight lift cage with an illuminated lever on the far left
a glass-walled service elevator with open doors up high above a central ladder
a wooden rowing boat tied to a brass dock cleat on the far right
